text:
Priya: hey team :wave: I'm Priya, joined backend today. First-week checklist — I'm trying to attach a new project to our GCP billing account and I'm blocked. I can't link the project and also don't see eu-west1 resources. Who should I ping for billing + cross-project IAM?

Jamal: @Priya welcome! For GCP billing infra usually grants the Billing Account User (roles/billing.user) at the project level. If you open a ticket in #help with your project ID I can do the service-account link. Also mention if you need the billing account itself to be visible.

Priya: thx @Jamal — project ID is `redwood-dev-priya`. I tried this and got permission denied:
```
gcloud alpha billing projects link redwood-dev-priya --billing-account=0123AB-4567CD
```

Jamal: yep that CLI error means you don't have billing permissions. Please include the project ID in the ticket and tag @Theo. I can grant `roles/billing.user` for that project once onboarding checks pass.

Theo: @Priya added the onboarding checklist step for billing. I started the request — ETA ~1h. For EU region access, make sure your IAM has `compute.instances.list` and `storage.objects.list` on the project; if not, tell me which resources you're trying to reach.

Ava: Security note: before we assign billing roles we need SSO + MFA on your account and a signed infra access form. @Priya can you confirm SSO is set up and drop the signed form link here? 

Priya: SSO done, MFA enabled. I uploaded the signed infra form at https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/forms/priya-signed.pdf — thanks!

gcp-bot: Ticket #12345 created in #help and assigned to Jamal. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-789. Please follow up there for audit trail.

Mike: AWS side — I added the org ReadOnly role mapping for your account. Try `aws sts get-caller-identity` and confirm you can list accounts. If you still can't see eu resources in the console, let me know which account ID and region.

Priya: ran `aws sts get-caller-identity` — looks good. Thanks everyone! I filed the #help ticket and linked this thread. :thumbsup:

Jamal: closing loop — I granted `roles/billing.user` on `redwood-dev-priya` and linked it to billing account 0123AB-4567CD. You should be able to run the earlier gcloud command now.

Priya: can confirm the gcloud link command worked and I can view billing. Appreciate the quick help! :tada:
